SKAU Non Teaching Post Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

SKAU Non Teaching Post Online Form 2026. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 21/08/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Non Teaching Post
  • Last Date : 21/08/2026
  • Apply Online Start Date : 30/07/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 21/08/2026 upto 04:00 PM
  • Admit Card Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : September 2026
  • Result Date : As Per Schedule
  • All Female General Category for Haryana Candidates : Rs. 750/-

Application Fee

  • Salary / Pay Scale : Staff Nurse Pay Scale : FPL-6 (Rs. 35400-112400) Ayurvedic Pharmacist Pay Scale : FPL-6 (Rs. 35400-112400) Clerk Pay Scale : FPL-2 (Rs. 19900-63200)
  • Last Date : 21/08/2026
  • Apply Online Start Date : 30/07/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 21/08/2026 upto 04:00 PM
  • General / Other State : Rs. 1500/-
  • All Female General Category for Haryana Candidates : Rs. 750/-
  • OSC / DSC / BC-A / EWS : Rs. 375/-
  • Post Name : Total Post
  • Staff Nurse : 25 Post
  • Ayurvedic Pharmacist : 06 Post

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
